name: net_resync_clears_stale_notices
description: An order refused while the window reconnects leaves its notice ('Reconnecting to the server'), and the wave banner may still name a wave from before the drop. When the RESYNC's checkpoint loads, the world jumps to it: both are cleared, so the screen says only what the connection plate says (catching up).

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Reconnecting to the server' and node('Banner').visible
steps.msg: an order while the link is down is refused with a notice; a banner is up
the checkpoint loaded: the stale notice and banner are gone
